thread:
alex: quick heads-up — ACMECorp private rollout is in the staged handoff window. They hit a failure on canary step 2 (agent->controlplane egress). looking for owners: who is owning NAT egress fallback and the cert rotation for the airgapped bundles?

mike_net: i can take NAT fallback. suspect it\u2019s SNAT+route policy — i saw dropped conntracks on the gateway earlier. planning to add a temporary SNAT rule and a 5min window to verify. ping me if you need ip ranges. :+1:

nisha_oncall: FYI oncall saw the same spike at 09:18 UTC — alerting flagged repeated TLS handshake timeouts to redwood-control-1. we silenced until we have owner.

rachel_cs: customer is paused on the next test; they need a short ETA to keep their network team on standby. also they asked about whether the fallback will require a config change on their side.

mike_net: should be transparent to customer if we do gateway SNAT. only change if we ask them to update allowed egress destinations. will confirm after test.

sam_platform: quick note re: the canary agent image — PR #457 has the fix but its blocked by one failing integration test (kube-prober). i pushed a patch to the PR to log more detail. can someone from SRE re-run the infra job?

kevin_sre: i can run the infra job. re-run queued, linking job id: job/infra-2026-04-12-87. if it passes we can merge and re-trigger canary.

alex: thanks kevin. mike, can you give a short snippet of the SNAT change you intend to apply so we can annotate runbook + CS message? rachel, can you tell the customer we'll aim for a 30min window to validate and that we won't need config changes unless we hit a corner case?

mike_net: snippet below (will apply in preprod then prod if green):
```bash
# add SNAT to gateway-nat for canary tenant
sudo iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s 10.240.0.0/24 -o eth0 -j MASQUERADE
# limit conntrack purge to 60s for test
echo 60 > /proc/sys/net/netfilter/nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_established
```

mike_net: after that i'll tail gateway logs for TLS handshake errors and report back in ~10m.

rachel_cs: perfect, i told ACME were investigating and set expectation: 30-45m. they appreciate the update. i also captured their internal firewall owners as: j.suarez@acme and infra-noc@acme.

nisha_oncall: reminder: if gateway logs show >3x handshake errors in 5m, we escalate to SEs and open an incident. otherwise track here.

sam_platform: on the PR front, if kevin's infra job passes and i merge #457, we should re-run the canary job. tagging @deploy-bot to schedule canary-2 in 15m after merge.

deploy-bot: scheduled: canary-2 will run in 15 minutes post-merge. notifying eng-oncall and infra.

kevin_sre: infra job passed (job/infra-2026-04-12-87 SUCCESS). merging PR now.

sam_platform: merged #457, started canary-2. deploy logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/9987 (tailing).

mike_net: SNAT rule applied in preprod, monitoring. gateway logs show TLS errors dropping from ~120/min to ~2/min after rule — looks good so far.

alex: excellent. mike, please port the rule to prod at +10 once canary-2 shows green. rachel ill draft a short customer note: "we applied a temporary egress NAT to stabilize control-plane handshakes; no action required from your network team unless we ask for specific allowlist updates."

rachel_cs: ack, ill send that and include the runbook link.

mike_net: will port at +10 and post confirmation.

kevin_sre: quick follow-up: we should add an automated smoke to detect this TLS-handshake surge and attach a playbook. i can own the alert if product agrees.

alex: good call. adding to backlog for post-rollout retro. kevin, mark as owner.

mike_net: prod SNAT applied, metrics look stable. posting final check in 5m. :white_check_mark:

alex: thank you all — closing the handoff when we confirm the customer test completes. note: add a short blurb in the private-deploy rollouts doc about NAT fallback pattern.

rachel_cs: customer completed tests and confirmed traffic steady. they said thanks. :tada:

alex: great job team. reopening if anything else pops up.
notes: async coordination thread: status, owners, PR/CI, temp SNAT fix, customer comms
